context: You previously encountered a small bandit crew near the abandoned Chapel of Selûne — Gimblebock led the group with underlings like Quelanna and Taman arguing about whether to loot the crashed nautiloid and worrying about their friend inside. Now, a bandit stationed in the chapel’s inner sanctum (sample line from Barton) spots you, shouts a warning to clear off, and immediately goes hostile. These lines are short taunts/commands delivered as combat is about to begin; there is no meaningful parley in this inner-sanctum trigger. The example exchanges show the bandits reacting to a perceived threat and preparing to attack at once.
